interface.label: Telemetry
interface.description: Export logs, metrics, and traces in the OTLP/HTTP JSON encoding. The default is the workspace's own activity store (query/traces stay native); vendor backends are bound as named profiles.

compat.label: Sentry
compat.unavailable: Sentry's OTLP ingestion is trace-focused and DSN-keyed; a logs/metrics mapping does not exist yet.
